scientific_integrity: A fully exact integer-pair checker performs the finite combinatorial classification. Analytical spherical excess and edge-separation expectation establish continuous probabilities; no finite simulation is treated as a proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to uniform orientations of central planes through a regular Euclidean dodecahedron; fixed offset and affine deformation are not covered. The known 10-circle cell partition is credited, and full French-Jordan 2010 text was inaccessible. Historical novelty is provisional, not independently verified.
title: The exact Haar polygon-type law of central regular-dodecahedron sections
